raw_response:
This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" across various language families for six different models or metrics. The horizontal axis represents the categorical variable "family," with categories arranged alphabetically from left to right: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the numerical value "effect" on a linear scale, ranging from approximately -5 to 35, with major tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30). Within each language family category, the data is visually arranged into a cluster of six adjacent bars. According to the legend, these bars correspond to different configurations, distinguished by color: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). Every bar is visually emphasized with a black, capped error bar indicating variability. The bar heights vary widely, with the tallest bars located in the IE-Indic category, specifically for mBERT-B₂ at approximately 24 and XLM-B₂ at approximately 21. Conversely, several bars have values near zero, such as mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ in the Isolate category, while others extend below the zero line into negative values, most notably the mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ bars in the Semitic category, which reach approximately -2.5 and -1, respectively.
